description: Received May 1960, flew with ARDU and 1 AFTS Pearce and was disposed of in 1970; noted in a Perth scrapyard in 1971 and later civil registered VH-HRR then VH-HRT. Displayed at the rear of the Bill's Machinery property fitted with the wings of A79-660. Two Vampire entries are listed for this site by AviationWA, both with unconfirmed identity; only one airframe is recorded here (ADF-Serials).
aliases: Vampire; DH115; Vampire T.35; Vampire T35; VH-HRT; c/n 4185

description: Fuselage only at the rear of the property; the wings were used in the rebuild of VH-WDE.
Agricultural aircraft airframe at the rear of the property. Believed to be VH-MPB but the identity is unconfirmed, so no registration is recorded.
